answer: The glacier report shows the merge explicitly at each bridge. Each collapsed cluster gets one marble weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. Because of that, anyone who spins up 242 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 54 times the capital for one share. A farm of 1960 identities would post 1429 proofs and burn roughly 90 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
